title: The written word
summary: How durable writing was invented in Sumer, alphabetized in the Levant, papered in Han China, block-printed under the Tang, and pressed in Mainz.

title: The spread of Buddhism
summary: From the Buddha's teaching in India through Ashoka's patronage to its arrival in Han China and the first printed sutra.

title: The Mongol world
summary: The steppe conquests that stitched Eurasia together — and what traveled the routes they opened, from dynasties to the plague.

title: The Atlantic exchange
summary: Contact, conquest, and the forced crossings that bound four continents into one Atlantic world.
